user_query: I'm organizing a company event and I need ideas for team-building activities. Can you show me trending images of team-building exercises and provide me with a list of local companies that offer such activities? Additionally, I would like to know the supported countries for Bing Web Search.

TaskList.description: Retrieve trending images related to team-building exercises.
Gather a list of local companies that offer team-building activities.
Fetch the list of supported countries for Bing Web Search.
